title: Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino (Theme 11: Ushuru)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child drops ki- and adds ji- for the big form (kitabu -> jitabu) or kiji- for the small form (kijitabu), with LI-YA or KI-VI agreement.

floor.prerequisite: Makes big and small forms of m- nouns.
floor.question: Ukubwa wa "mtoto" ni?

contexts: a giant chair in a story

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kitabu kikubwa sana huitwa ___." Kwa nini "kijitabu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ukubwa hupata ji-, udogo hupata kiji-. Kijitabu ni kitabu kidogo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kitabu kikubwa sana huitwa ___." Kwa nini "vitabu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Vitabu ni wingi wa kitabu. Kitabu kikubwa sana ni jitabu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kisu kidogo huitwa ___." Kwa nini "kisu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ukubwa na udogo hubadilisha mwanzo wa nomino: kisu, kijisu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Wingi wa "jitabu" ni ___." Kwa nini "jitabu" si jibu sahihi?
